_readme: Curated, hiss-free sound library. 'peak' = seconds into the file where it hits (measured with npx hyperframes audio --json). 'lp' = low-pass in Hz applied when mixing. 'use' = when to use it. Only names listed here may appear in cues.json. Every sound is used at most ~6 times per video unless it is a melodic run.

swoosh.use: section change (automatic rotation); something sweeping past

swish.use: section change (automatic rotation); a quick flip or reshape

pop.use: a label/tag appears; a small thing appears

woodblock.use: counting, lists, ticks (use 'run' for a rising run of notes)

tom.use: under a letter slam (automatic); a heavy landing

impact-bass-1.use: under a letter slam (automatic); the payoff

riser.use: builds into the payoff (automatic, cues.json payoff)

boing.use: a shape snaps into place; something springy or funny

snap.use: something brittle cracks or snaps (ice, a twig, a bond breaking)

inflate.use: something inflates, swells or fills with air (lasts ~2 s; peak = fully inflated)

toggle.use: a switch, lever or button is pressed (once; never per word)

squeak.use: rubber stretching or squeaking; something elastic

rumble.use: rocket engines igniting / a launch roar (deep, no hiss)

boom.use: an explosion or a huge impact (deep cinematic boom)

clang.use: heavy steel meets steel: a clamp, a catch, arms closing

cheer.use: a room of people cheering (once per video, gain <= 0.2)

beep.use: a radio / mission-control beep, a status call

clunk.use: a mechanical release: a door, a latch, a satellite let go

sonicboom.use: a returning rocket's sonic boom (deep double thump)

bricks.use: plastic bricks clattering: brick debris landing, a build snapping apart (max 3)

servo.use: motors moving: flaps, grid fins, tower arms swinging (set max_len 1.2-2)

thud.use: a heavy soft landing / a big part settling

chime.use: a gentle success ping: orbit reached, satellites out

creak.use: big steel structure under load (tower arms taking the weight)

_banned: glitch-1, glitch-2, glitch-3, sparkle, key-press, click, click-soft: hiss / camera-shutter sounds. Never add them. Also rejected: hydraulic-press (65% >4 kHz) and rocket-ignition (69% >4 kHz) hisses; a hissy 'rocket engine' (sfx_011, 70% above 4 kHz) and applause (noise).
